title: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering at code.talks
abstract: I spoke at code.talks in Hamburg about moving from vibe coding to agentic engineering. About 150 people showed up on Stage 3. Notes from the talk, the crowd, the sessions I sat in, and where things go next.
meta-title: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering | code.talks Hamburg
meta-description: Notes from my 20-minute talk at code.talks 2026 in Hamburg: vibe coding vs agentic engineering, the keyboard question from the crowd, and sessions worth catching.
